## Property Listing (PL)

The property page a buyer would read: address, beds/baths/area, asking price, photo gallery (reusing the catalog’s MultiImageSourceField), agent, and a draft → published → under-offer → sold lifecycle whose publish moment is an event fact. Deliberately distinct from the marketplace `Listing` (sole-vault): a property is located and sold once, a collectible is shipped and priced per unit.

### Non-goals

No offers/bidding flow (an Offer on a property would be its own card). No MLS/syndication integration. No mortgage math.

### Marketplace extension (2026-09-03)

Additive: `lotSizeSqft`, `neighborhood`, `features[]` (pills on the property page), `mlsNumber`, `hoaFee`, `heroIndex` + `photoCaptions[]` (managed by Photo Organizer), computeds `daysOnMarket` (from `publishedAt`, only while on the market), `pricePerSqft`, `photoCount`. Status ladder gained `prepared` and `expired` (existing values untouched; the spec's Active/Pending map to published/under-offer). The isolated view now carries the full publish panel: pre-publish checklist, channel selector, schedule picker, and the Publish button (draft/prepared only, lazy-imports the command to avoid a module cycle).
